snippet.title: Database Detective: Minor Crimes Division | Gameplay Trailer | Gamflix
snippet.description:
A new (unpaid) work from home opportunity has opened up in Los Zorangeles! Become the police department’s new Database Detective and help the Minor Crimes Division solve small misdemeanors through the power of SQL queries.

Minimum:
OS: Windows 10
Processor: Anything from the past 20 years
Memory: 4 GB RAM
Graphics: Yes
DirectX: Version 10
Storage: 2 GB available space

Minimum:
OS: Big Sur 11
Processor: Apple Silicon
Memory: 4 GB RAM
Graphics: Yes
Storage: 2 GB available space

Minimum:
OS: Ubuntu 22.04
Processor: Whatever you have :)
Memory: 4 GB RAM
Graphics: Yes
